title: DEBUNKED: PBS Insane Lies About Native Americas
description:
Ken Burns' new documentary paints Native tribes as peaceful environmentalists with advanced political systems.

But the record shows the opposite: constant tribal warfare, no democratic institutions, mass overhunting, and no technological development to sustain the land they claimed was “everlasting.”

Nothing about that resembles the country we live in today, and pretending otherwise doesn’t make it true.
